banks.title: Listening GT Section 3: Diskusi Pelatihan Keamanan Pangan Hotel

questions.prompt: Why must the staff complete the food safety course?
questions.explanation_id: Keluhan soal prasmanan dingin bukan alasannya: "The real reason is that the city council has introduced a new regulation."
options: A guest complained about the cold buffet
The city council introduced a new regulation
The hotel is opening a new restaurant
correct_answers: The city council introduced a new regulation

questions.prompt:
Complete the notes. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER.

Number of online modules: ________
questions.explanation_id: Dulu ada delapan modul, tetapi sekarang "it's six modules in total".

questions.prompt: Deadline for the online modules: the end of ________
questions.explanation_id: Linda berkata: "you need to finish all of them by the end of February" karena inspeksi awal Maret.

questions.prompt: Choose TWO letters. Which TWO topics did Jenny find difficult?
questions.explanation_id: Jenny berkata: "I agree about allergens. And I struggled with temperature control, too." Modul kebersihan dan pengendalian hama dianggap mudah.

questions.prompt: The practical session will be held in the ________ kitchen.
questions.explanation_id: Dapur utama terlalu sibuk, jadi dipakai "the banqueting kitchen on the lower floor".

questions.prompt: Who will do each of the following tasks before the practical session?
questions.explanation_id: Linda memesan sesi karena harus menandatangani kontrak, Jenny mencetak lembar log suhu ("I can print the temperature log sheets"), dan Marcus memperbarui kartu alergen ("I'll update the allergen cards on the menu").

left: Update the allergen cards on the menu

questions.prompt: Pass mark for the final test: ________ percent
questions.explanation_id: Nilai lulus dulu 75 persen, tetapi dinaikkan: "now you need eighty percent to pass".

questions.prompt: What does Linda say about the certificate?
questions.explanation_id: Linda menjelaskan: "You'll need to renew it every three years", dan biaya perpanjangan ditanggung hotel.
options: It must be renewed every three years
Staff must pay for the renewal themselves
It can only be used at this hotel
correct_answers: It must be renewed every three years

questions.prompt: Bonus for passing on the first attempt: $________
questions.explanation_id: Manajemen setuju memberi "a one-time bonus of one hundred and fifty dollars".

questions.prompt: Contact for questions about the course: Mr ________ (Human Resources)
